svg.title: Forest Service — British Columbia — Airtanker Operations
svg.desc: Editable vector reconstruction from the supplied image, assembled from geometric ovals, mirrored wing instances, hand-authored landscape paths, reusable conifer symbols, and live text on paths. Not an official master. Flat colours replace the raster shading; the lettering is an approximation.
svg.metadata: Authored reconstruction; no bitmap, raster contour tracing, or embedded font. Geometry source: generate.py. Palette: #002950, #FFCA05, #FFECC0, #EB001B.
